lunch3_start.name: Yuna
lunch3_start.text: Have some of my bread, too. *Lunch on the third day. Seoyeon sits beside me, Dain across from me. Yuna pulls up a chair.*

lunch3_start_2_b.name: Dain
lunch3_start_2_b.text: I can try this first, right? ...Okay, just a taste. *Dain takes the rolled omelet before Yuna. Seoyeon looks across the table before lifting her chopsticks.*

lunch3_meal_1.name: Dain
lunch3_meal_1.text: Oh, this is good. Have some too, President. Getting here first doesn't mean you get all of it today.

lunch3_meal_2.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_2.text: Hold on, that's a side from my lunchbox.

lunch3_meal_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_3.text: I have no intention of monopolizing someone else's lunchbox. The rolled omelette gets a six.

lunch3_meal_4.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_4.text: Don't coldly score someone else's lunch sides.

lunch3_meal_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_5.text: *The corner of Seoyeon's mouth curls, just enough to annoy me.* 6 out of 10 is a pretty generous score by my standards.

lunch3_meal_6.name: Yuna
lunch3_meal_6.text: *Yuna, watching in silence, reaches out with her chopsticks and picks up the most tempting Vienna sausage from the middle of the lunchbox.*

lunch3_meal_7.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_7.text: Yuna, that scored sausage was the one I was saving.

lunch3_meal_7_b.name: Yuna
lunch3_meal_7_b.text: *Yuna looks at Dain while chewing the sausage.* So the first person to grab it doesn't get to keep it.

lunch3_meal_10.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10.text: Hey, wait! That's the last piece left. *The moment I shout, the tips of three pairs of chopsticks freeze in the air just above the lunchbox.*

lunch3_meal_10_b.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_b.text: *In the middle of the empty lunchbox, one last piece of golden-brown rolled omelet sits all by itself.*

lunch3_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_choice.text: *At the table, even the breathing has gone quiet. I choose who gets the last side.*

lunch3_give_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon's eyes curve, satisfied.* Thanks. You really do know who to look after when it matters.

lunch3_give_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon sets her chopsticks down on the lunchbox.* Forget it. You eat it.

lunch3_seo_skin_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_1.text: Wait, you've got something by your mouth. Hold still. Don't move. *Seoyeon leans in close, lightly holds the tip of my chin, and slowly picks off the grain of rice stuck beside my lip with her thumb.*

lunch3_seo_skin_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_2.text: *Seoyeon's finger at the edge of my lip doesn't pull away right away. A lower voice brushes past my ear.* Be a little more careful in front of the others. I can't wipe this off for you every time.

lunch3_seo_skin_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_3.text: Ah, my chopsticks. It's fine. I'll pick them up, so stay still. *As she draws her hand back, Seoyeon picks up the chopsticks that rolled off the edge of the desk and hides her reddened ear behind her hair.*

lunch3_give_seo_2.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_2.text: Aw, that's cheap! I was totally going for that last piece too!

lunch3_seo_witness_1.name: Dain
lunch3_seo_witness_1.text: I'm thirsty. I'll go refill my water. *Dain picks up the empty bottle, glances once toward Seoyeon's lunchbox, then slips out into the hall.*

lunch3_seo_witness_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_choice.text: *The heels of Dain's sneakers, always so loud, disappear without a sound around the hall corner.*
choices: It’d be more fun if we invited Dain too.
I feel bad leaving Dain alone. I will ask her to come back.

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.text: *When I stand, Seoyeon sets the lunchbox down without a word and lines the lid corners up straight.*

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_2.text: *Stopped at the hall water fountain, Dain turns around, fidgeting with only her bottle.* Why'd you follow me? You didn't even finish eating with the president.

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_2b.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_2b.text: *I calmed Dain down and brought her back to her seat in the classroom.*

lunch3_seo_focus_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_focus_2.text: *Seoyeon picks at a side with her chopstick tips and asks, low.* You're with me, and someone else is still on your mind?

lunch3_give_seo_3.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_3.text: *Without a word, Yuna folds the leftover bread bag twice and tucks it inside her bag.*

lunch3_give_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch3_give_dain_1.text: You're really giving it to me? Thanks! {name}, you know how I feel better than anyone!

lunch3_give_dain_neg.name: Dain
lunch3_give_dain_neg.text: *Dain picks up her water bottle instead of her chopsticks.* I'm full. I'm good.

lunch3_dain_skin_1.name: Dain
lunch3_dain_skin_1.text: Thanks for giving up something that good. Can I hug you once, as a reward? *Dain gulps down the rolled omelet, rises halfway, and opens her arms. Before she even hears my answer, she pulls me in by the neck and burrows against me.*

lunch3_dain_skin_3.name: Dain
lunch3_dain_skin_3.text: *Through her athletic clothes, Dain's heat and her fast heartbeat come straight through. Half a beat later she pulls back and scratches her flushed cheek.* Now that I hugged you first, this is way more embarrassing than I thought.

lunch3_give_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_2.text: *Seoyeon gathers her chopstick tips and lets out a small sigh.* Honestly. So much for scoring it so carefully.

lunch3_dain_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_witness_1.text: *Yuna looks back and forth between Dain's bright smile and my face. Then, without a word, she shifts the book she was reading past the lunchbox and blocks her view.*

lunch3_give_dain_3.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_3.text: *Yuna rolls the mouth of the empty bread bag tight in her fingers and turns toward the window.*

lunch3_give_yuna_1.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_yuna_1.text: *Yuna's eyes waver, then a faint smile spreads.* Thanks. You gave it to me, so I'll eat all of it.

lunch3_give_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna folds the bread bag and shakes her head.* I'm okay.

lunch3_yuna_skin_1.name: Yuna
lunch3_yuna_skin_1.text: A thank-you. Take this. *Under the desk, the moment Yuna hands me the note, her cold, smooth fingers press deep into my palm, as if wrapping my hand.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_2.name: Yuna
lunch3_yuna_skin_2.text: *Yuna doesn't pull her hand away. She quietly squeezes my finger joints.* When I said thanks earlier, that wasn't just being polite.

lunch3_yuna_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_3.text: *Yuna stays a long while, as if leaving her warmth on my fingertips, then slowly lets go. I fold the note left in my palm and put it in my pocket.*

lunch3_give_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_2.text: *Seoyeon sets her chopsticks down neatly, the way she would set down a teacup.* I was sure it would come to me. That's a surprise.

lunch3_yuna_witness_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_yuna_witness_1.text: You look after her right in front of me, then watch my face too. Where does that leave me? Don't worry about it. Just eat.

lunch3_yuna_witness_2.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_witness_2.text: *Yuna taps the side of her water cup once with her index finger, then meets Seoyeon's eyes without looking away.*

lunch3_give_yuna_3.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_3.text: Huh? What! So there's nothing for me at all?

lunch3_expose_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_1.text: *Near the end of the meal, Dain, closing her water bottle, speaks up out of nowhere.*

lunch3_expose_2.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_2.text: Oh, right! We said we'd meet this weekend. Did we decide what time, and where?

lunch3_expose_3.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_3.text: Huh? Wait, Dain. That talk can wait. *A chill runs down my spine, and the chopsticks in my hand go stiff.*

lunch3_expose_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_4.text: *The tip of Seoyeon's chopsticks presses the edge of the plastic lunchbox until it goes white. Yuna stops tearing her bread bag and looks at Dain with cold eyes.*

lunch3_expose_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_6.text: *The warmth drops clean out of Seoyeon's voice.* Wait. What you just said. You mean I'm not the only weekend plan?

lunch3_expose_7.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_7.text: *The smile slowly leaves Dain's face.* What? That's weird. I think the three of us each heard a different answer about who you're meeting, and when.

lunch3_expose_7_b.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_7_b.text: *Yuna sets down the bread she was eating and, without a sound, rolls the bag shut all the way.*

lunch3_expose_10.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_10.text: *Someone's metal chopstick hits the lunchbox lid with a cold clink. No one picks it up.*

lunch3_expose_11.name: Yuna
lunch3_expose_11.text: I saw Seoyeon and Dain ask you first. I didn't know you'd accepted every one of those plans.

lunch3_expose_12.name: Minsu
lunch3_expose_12.text: Hey, come here a second. *From the next row, Minsu, who'd been watching the room, covers his mouth with his hand and waves me over in a hurry.*

lunch3_expose_14.name: Minsu
lunch3_expose_14.text: *Minsu grabs my shoulder and whispers, like he can't believe it.* Hey, have you actually lost it? How many plans did you stack on one weekend?

lunch3_expose_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_choice.text: *Three cold stares are fixed on my mouth. What do I say right now?*
choices: I'm sorry. I like all of you, and I couldn't say no.
The times are different, so wouldn't it be okay?

lunch3_expose_honest_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_1.text: I'm really sorry. I didn't want to turn even one of you down. I like all of you, so I couldn't say no.

lunch3_expose_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_2.text: *Seoyeon draws a small breath, like she can't believe it.* You couldn't say no? That excuse is the cruelest one, {name}.

lunch3_expose_honest_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_3.text: That half-smile you give because you don't want to be hated makes the person waiting think they're special.

lunch3_expose_honest_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_4.text: *Seoyeon snaps the lid shut on the lunchbox she hasn't finished.*

lunch3_expose_honest_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_5.text: I won't sit there as one of several in some vague spot. If that's how it is, I'll step out first.

lunch3_expose_honest_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_6.text: *Seoyeon picks up her lunch bag and walks out the classroom door without looking back.*

lunch3_expose_honest_7.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_7.text: *Dain, left behind, only nods once and looks away. Not a trace of her usual excitement is left in her voice.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_1.text: The days and times are a little different, so seeing all of you should be fine, right?

lunch3_expose_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_excuse_2.text: *Seoyeon's eyes go cold as ice.* You really don't get it? Whether the times overlap is the problem.

lunch3_expose_excuse_2_b.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_2_b.text: *Dain shoves her chair back, stands, and slings her bag over one shoulder.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_3.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_3.text: My head's a mess too. Give me some time to think.

lunch3_expose_excuse_4.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_4.text: *Dain stuffs the still-wrapped soboro bun into her bag and leaves with a stiff face.*

lunch3_expose_run_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_1.text: *Instead of answering, I push the back door and slip into the hall like I'm running. Behind me, chair legs scrape the floor all at once.*

lunch3_expose_run_2.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_2.text: *From the classroom I only hear chairs dragging, one after another. No one follows me out. All through afternoon class, nothing on the board registers, and under the desk I keep turning my phone screen on and off.*

lunch3_share_1.name: {name}
lunch3_share_1.text: Don't fight. Let's cut it even and share. That's fair, right? *All three break into a faint laugh, but the chopstick tips in their hands stay strangely still.*

lunch3_share_cool.name: {name}
lunch3_share_cool.text: *I split the last piece of rolled omelet into three. Only a light quiet sits over the table. The laughter doesn't go on.*

lunch3_share_neg.name: {name}
lunch3_share_neg.text: *The cut rolled omelet stays in the middle of the lunchbox. No one moves their chopsticks, and one of them has already closed the lid.*

lunch3_share_solo.name: {name}
lunch3_share_solo.text: *Even after they share the last piece without a fuss, the three of them don't get up easily.*

lunch3_harem_1.name: {name}
lunch3_harem_1.text: *The three of them share the pieces, a little each. Seoyeon only smiles with her eyes, and Dain laughs extra loud for show, but Yuna never takes the note out of her pocket.*

lunch3_end.name: {name}
lunch3_end.text: *At the bell that ends lunch, everyone closes their lunchbox. In the end, no one brings up the weekend plans again.*

lunch3_give_seo_dain_mid.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_dain_mid.text: Aw, what a waste. I wanted some too! Next time you have to save my share first.

lunch3_give_seo_dain_low.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_dain_low.text: *Dain swallows the rest of her own bread and screws the cap on her water bottle.* I'm already full. I'm fine.

lunch3_give_seo_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_yuna_mid.text: *Yuna quietly looks at the side handed to Seoyeon, then folds the bread bag.* Next time, save a little for me too.

lunch3_give_seo_yuna_low.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_yuna_low.text: *Without much of a reaction, Yuna puts the rest of the bread in her mouth.*

lunch3_give_dain_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_seo_mid.text: *Seoyeon sets her chopsticks down and lines up the corners of the lunchbox lid.* Next time, take the score I gave into account a little.

lunch3_give_dain_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon neatly tidies the remaining sides and only gives a short nod.*

lunch3_give_dain_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_yuna_mid.text: So today it goes to Dain. Next time, ask me first too.

lunch3_give_dain_yuna_low.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_yuna_low.text: *Yuna folds the empty bread bag away and takes a sip of water.*

lunch3_give_yuna_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_seo_mid.text: You're looking after Yuna first. All right. I get it.

lunch3_give_yuna_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_seo_low.text: *Without a word, Seoyeon puts away her own lunchbox and utensil case.*

lunch3_give_yuna_dain_mid.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_dain_mid.text: Well, Yuna's been eyeing it since earlier! Next time it's my turn, no question.

lunch3_give_yuna_dain_low.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_dain_low.text: *Dain sticks the empty water bottle into the side pocket of her bag.* I'm fine. Eat plenty.

lunch3_give_seo_dain_neg.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_dain_neg.text: *Dain picks up nothing but her water bottle and walks out to the hall. Not a word of goodbye.*

lunch3_give_seo_yuna_neg.name: {name}
lunch3_give_seo_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna folds the bread bag, puts it in her bag, and stands up before anyone else.*

lunch3_give_dain_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon closes the lunchbox lid and walks out of the classroom with only the attendance book in her arms.*

lunch3_give_dain_yuna_neg.name: {name}
lunch3_give_dain_yuna_neg.text: *When I look back, Yuna's seat is already empty. Even the note she always leaves isn't there.*

lunch3_give_yuna_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_seo_neg.text: *Walking down the hall, Seoyeon doesn't even glance at the windows toward the library.*

lunch3_give_yuna_dain_neg.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_dain_neg.text: *Dain tucks one volleyball under her arm and walks toward the gym. She doesn't look back once.*
